title: Scoped navigation search
responsibility: Accepts search entries only for the currently displayed revision and validates result destinations.

inputs.name: navbarSearch.scope
inputs.description: The currently displayed explorer scope, or null when no scope is available. Its commit is compared with candidate entry commits, and its location supplies the destination branch and commit.

inputs.name: navbarSearch.given
inputs.description: Candidate search entries, or null/undefined while unavailable. Entries are usable only when a location exists and every entry's commit equals scope?.commit; one mismatch rejects the whole set.

outputs.name: navbarSearch
outputs.description: Returns the supplied entries only when a location exists and every entry's commit equals scope?.commit; otherwise entries is null. Its label indicates history, a pinned short commit, or the tip of scope.branch (falling back to “the retained commits”), while at resolves only entries with a matching commit/category/id key to the current location's branch and commit.
